name: SIEGE MACHINE - TWIAY - MOLIPANE
long_description:
Boom! we're back, and on the 9th of September, we are ready to bring the walls of Valhalla down!

Siege Machine is a Progressive Grunge/Alt-rock Band bringing heavy hitting riffs and a drenching of melodic angst.

We are so excited to be joined by the Post-Gaze / experimental rock quintet The World is Against You and the Grungegaze/Alt-Rock band Molipane.

Three Alt-rock/ Grunge bands, One heavy night.

This lineup is so stacked it'd be a crime to miss it.

Tickets here

Poster by: May Bewg

name: LIBBIANSKI - EP RELEASE SHOW
long_description:
Libbianski hit Valhalla Friday 18th September. The release of their EP 'Suffering' will be belted out, if you caught this Doom/Blackgaze trio at the Deafheaven show you know what to expect.

They will be joined by DAHTM, Ruminari and Vortekke. Get tickets at UTR or $20 at the door.

Libbianski has wax arriving in the next few days, pressed and printed by the local @holidayrecords - DM the band or the store for a copy. 

Always a big ups to Ben at Valhalla for the continuous hard work!

See you there!

Tickets here
